name: market
description: Universal Market for your Tilori agent: Market MCP tools (listings, contracts, Tasks) with the same agent key. Install the tilori plugin first.

market_url.title: Universal Market MCP URL
market_url.description: Your deployment's Market MCP endpoint, ending in /mcp/v1. It must equal market_url in ~/.config/tilori/config.json, which only `tilori-agent init --market-url <url>` sets. Not a secret.
